title: Choose the next steps to cut CI time

elements.markdown: Each of four jobs repeats a 2-minute install; integration tests take 11 minutes with a shared Postgres database. These are promising targets, but cache effectiveness and safe parallelism still need evidence. Combine options below; defaults are proposals.

elements.multi: What should we work on next?

options.description: Establish install and integration timings before changing the workflow.
May reduce the repeated installs; compare cold and warm runs before relying on it.
May shorten the 11-minute suite, with isolation work and potentially more billed runner minutes.
Save runner minutes on docs edits while retaining the complete release matrix.
Reduce routine PR work, with a risk of finding macOS or Windows regressions later.

Measure first.input: Representative PRs to measure (leave blank for me to choose)
Measure first.placeholder: For example: docs-only, small code change, integration-heavy change

Experiment with dependency caching.text: Compare cold and warm installs, verify dependency-lockfile invalidation, and keep a clean-install fallback.

Isolate and parallelize integration test.select: How far should I take the parallel-test work?

options.description: Inspect shared state and propose per-worker databases without adding runner spend.
Try a small shard count with separate Postgres databases and check for state leakage and flaky failures.

Run a bounded isolation pilot.input: Maximum additional billed runner minutes for the pilot
Run a bounded isolation pilot.placeholder: Set a limit before I run the pilot

options.description: Isolates test data while retaining Postgres behavior.
Stronger isolation, with more setup and resource usage.

Skip unnecessary docs-only PR jobs.text: Inspect path filters and required-check behavior, retain checks for changes that affect code or builds, and preserve full release coverage.

options.description: Continue catching supported CLI platform regressions on every code PR.

options.value: Linux on every PR; all platforms before merge
options.description: Faster early feedback, but macOS and Windows failures arrive later.

options.value: Linux on PRs; all platforms on releases
options.description: Fewer PR runner minutes, with platform regressions potentially discovered at release time.

elements.text: Release coverage remains Linux, macOS, and Windows. Use a note to propose a different scope or override any selection.
